paragraphs.text: The Bazaar of Bassorah was a marketplace in the city of Bassorah on Rabiah the Infinite , near the Mosque Quarter.

The Bazaar of Bassorah is the second largest bazaar in Rabiah; although the Bazaar of Baghdad is larger, it does not have Bassorah's variety of goods. Sometimes, items from other planes are found in merchant's stalls. Often even the merchants have no idea where they picked up these items. The Bassorans refer to them as " Shahrazad 's gifts" due to their uncanny tendency to fall into the hands of those who most need them.
The Bazaar of Bassorah was where the Nomad Taysir found the Dervish Taysir and Raghib .
